title: Hiding
text: My fiancée actually asked me if I was out of my mind.

“Well, what she says might sound a little weird, but she’s actually pretty accurate. She saved me when I was about to be framed, and she’s told me about incidents that will happen in the future—and they’ve all happened exactly as she said.”
With a look like she’s about to cry, my fiancée stares at Father and me. That’s right—I’ve been looping through time over and over again. Predicting what’s going to happen is a piece of cake for me.

“Melty-chan, remember this well. I don’t actually want to destroy this country. There are good people here, after all. Besides, if I wanted to destroy it, I’d just go to Siltvelt and boldly declare to their leader, ‘Destroy Melromarc!’ That’s all it would take. If I did that… you’d be in big trouble, wouldn’t you, Melty-chan?”
“Yeah.”
“I’d be in trouble too. I didn’t come to this other world just to start a war. I’m here, just as I was asked, to save the world from the Waves.”
My fiancée looked relieved at Father’s words.

“Anyway, getting back to the topic—according to Motoyasu-kun, Melty-chan’s mother, the Queen, is supposed to revoke my wanted status within a few days. All that’s left is the Three Heroes Church running amok… If we can get past this, the commotion will die down.”
“What about Father… and my older sister?”
“Well, that’s—…”
“There will be a punishment. In the future, my Father will be punished by having his name changed to ‘Trash’ and ‘Crimson Swine’ will be called ‘Bitch.’”
For some reason, my finacée’s eyes are half-closed. Sakura-chan wraps her arms around my finacée from behind, as if to comfort her.
“Mel-chan, don’t cry.”
“It’s okay, Sakura-chan.”
“Or is it that you don’t trust the name-changing punishment?”
For some reason, my Finacée nods obediently.
“A name reflects a person’s character. I think it’s a fitting name change for those two.”
Trash and Crimson Swine both look quite displeased at that. Just thinking about it makes me laugh uncontrollably. Well, no matter what face a pig makes, it’s still just as unpleasant.

“As for that… maybe there just wasn’t any other good option? Since they’re indirectly connected to the country’s regent and the princess, even if only in a roundabout way, executing them… would be difficult given the queen’s position, so at most they’d be stripped of their power—but it seems they’re going to do even that.”
“I can believe that part.”

“In a way, if you think of it as a compromise—one that both kept me in a good mood and protected their families from death—I suppose I could accept it… or maybe not?　It seems the future me and the present me are quite different, so I guess I won’t really know until that time comes.”

My finacée nodded repeatedly in agreement with Father’s speculation. That queen—at first she looked like a pig to me, but since she was my finacée’s parent, I was able to recognize her as human. Considering that she maintained a decent relationship with Father even in later generations, one can tell she’s quite a remarkable figure.
“For now, I just want her to understand that we don’t want to destroy the country. So… until that queen returns, would it be okay if we just pretended to be hiding out in the country?”
“We can easily flee the country using the portal. The fact that we hid our escape from the Three Heroes Church will pay off.”
“That’s true. But still… would it be dangerous to take Melty-chan to Siltvelt?”
She is, after all, the princess of an enemy nation. Even if her Father is accompanying her, there’s definitely a risk that we don’t know what she might do.
“That said, it might actually be safer than staying in Melromarc, where we never know when an assassin might strike.”

“It’s not quite like ‘the light is darkest under the lamp’… but if we stay somewhere the enemy wouldn’t expect, we might indeed be safe. Alright, I’ll move our base of operations so we don’t get found. We’ll come back once the commotion dies down—or once we find out where the queen is.”
“Got it, big bro! Right, Melty-chan?”
“…Yes. I understand.”
“I don’t know how long it’ll take, but I’ll resolve this as quickly as possible, okay?”

My finacée hugged Sakura-chan and nodded at Father’s words. And so, we discreetly wrapped up our peddling and completed our move to Siltvelt. Even though we—the very people wanted by the authorities—had long since left the country, the Three Heroes Church was frantically searching for us, and the revolutionary movement was spreading throughout the nation… or so it was.
“Ahaha!”

A few days had passed since we’d moved to Siltvelt. With our money, levels, and equipment already in order, we were taking a break. My fiancée was happily playing tag with Sakura-chan, the Filolials, Keel, and my Assistant.
It’s quite a heartwarming sight, isn’t it? When Filo-tan isn’t around, there’s no hostility between my fiancée and me. There are no villains among those who love the Filolials.

My fiancée isn’t an enemy—she’s my Rival. In fact, the more I see her radiating such nobility, the more my drive to improve myself grows. My motivation to achieve my goal of meeting Filo-tan is skyrocketing.
“Hmm… It’s a bit inappropriate, but taking it easy like this makes me feel a little guilty. That said, there’s no way I could quell the commotion in Melromarc anyway…”
My future father stood by the window in his inn room and muttered this as he watched Filolial-sama, my Finacée, and Keel and the others playing. It’s already dusk outside.

Watching them like this, my Finacée really does seem like a child. How can a child like that get along so well with Filolial-sama and the others…? It’s probably because Filolial-sama and her companions are such pure-hearted people.
“Come to think of it, Lars-chan and the others weren’t here…”
“That Panda, right? I wonder where they went?”
“I don’t know… They’re mercenaries, after all. Maybe they found a job somewhere.”
“I’m back!”
My Finacée returned in high spirits.
“Welcome back. So, shall we go grab some dinner now?”
“Let’s go!”

She must be getting used to things, as her tone is becoming less reserved. Still, there’s a certain formality to it—or perhaps it’s just that she doesn’t seem to be speaking as openly as she does with Mirai. If I had to put it into words, there seems to be a bit of a distance between them, but Father and my Finacée don’t seem to feel any awkwardness at all.

After we all finished eating, we’re relaxing in our room at the inn. Perhaps because he was the first to comfort her, my Finacée seems to be getting along well with Sakura-chan. She’s running around the room, playing tag with Sakura-chan.
“Ahahaha, Sakura-chan, wait for me!”
“Over here, over here—Meru-chan!”
“Hey, hey, don’t get too rowdy. If you’re going to play tag, do it outside.”
“I’m, I’m sorry.”
My finacée snaps back to her senses and apologizes to my Father. Sakura-chan, with a dazed expression, pats my finacée on the head.
“Sakura was at fault too—Naofumi, I’m sorry!”
“It’s okay.”
“Melty-chan really is such a friendly and sweet girl!”
Seeing my fiancée like that, Keel said to Father,
“She doesn’t use her ‘princess’ status as an excuse.”
“I’ll use it if I need to. But I don’t need to here, right?”
“So, what are we going to play next?”
“Something that isn’t too rowdy, okay? It’s not like anyone’s going to come here, but just in case—we’re in hiding, after all.”
“Okay!”

It looked like my fiancée and the others were enjoying a quiet game they’d chosen to play in the room. Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and the others joined in too, and they seemed to be having a good time in their own way. I joined in as well. We played card games unique to this world. Eventually, my father called the game to a close and reminded everyone,
“It’s getting late, so let’s go to bed.”
“Okay!”
At my father’s prompting, my finacée and Sakura-chan got into bed. Keel and the Assistant were no exception. Oh, and Luna-chan, who’s always glued to Keel, is sleeping with him.
As for the Assistant, even though his Rival was sleeping in the stable, he apparently tried to sleep with him and got scolded. I guess humans and dragons are just different.

As for me, Kou is sleeping outside. He has no intention of sleeping in the stable, but he doesn’t want to sleep in the room either. Yuki-chan is already fast asleep in the room next door, where I’m planning to sleep.
